title: Practice: the Crown
summary: A small game against an Easy computer playing the Clockwork, with hints along the way. Destroy every enemy building to win.

say: A real game now, against an easy computer playing the Clockwork. I will give you hints.
Win by destroying every enemy building. First, more Labourers.
Good. Now a Cottage, a Powder Mill with Labourers in it, and a Barracks.
Keep the Barracks busy: Musketeers, one after another. An idle Barracks wins no wars.
Wall your ramp, and build a Foundry for cannons. The Clockwork's machines fear round shot.

say.pc: The enemy is in the far corner. Gather your army, press A and click their base.
say.phone: The enemy is in the far corner. Gather your army, tap ATTACK and tap their base.

late1.text: Your soil is running low by now. Build a second Town Hall at the foot of your ramp: fresh land.

lost: The computer won this time. Build up, defend your ramp, and try again.

you.text: You won a whole game. You are ready for a skirmish, or the campaign.
